# Authority fixture workspace

This disposable campaign exercises the authority ledger’s source boundary,
mixed classifications, audience metadata, and all four projection names. Its
five anchored note sections cover `CANON`, `TABLE`, `PREP`, `OVERLAY`, and
`OPEN`; `authority.yaml` also includes one `RULED` source correction. Tests
create external and symlink aliases in their temporary copies, so those paths
remain portable in a checked-out fixture.
